versions.subject: Merge PR #4452 from @SILJAEUROPA  - Add New Rules To AddInUtil Potential Abuse
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\addinutil.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'AddInUtil.exe'
selection_susp_1_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-AddInRoot:'
        - '-PipelineRoot:'
selection_susp_1_paths:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - '\Desktop\'
        - '\Downloads\'
        - '\Users\Public\'
        - '\Windows\Temp\'
selection_susp_2:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-AddInRoot:.'
        - '-AddInRoot:"."'
        - '-PipelineRoot:.'
        - '-PipelineRoot:"."'
    CurrentDirectory|contains:
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - '\Desktop\'
        - '\Downloads\'
        - '\Users\Public\'
        - '\Windows\Temp\'
condition: selection_img and (all of selection_susp_1_* or selection_susp_2)
versions.spl: Image="*\\addinutil.exe" OR OriginalFileName="AddInUtil.exe" (CommandLine IN ("*-AddInRoot:*", "*-PipelineRoot:*") CommandLine IN ("*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*", "*\\Desktop\\*", "*\\Downloads\\*", "*\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*")) OR (CommandLine IN ("*-AddInRoot:.*", "*-AddInRoot:\".\"*", "*-PipelineRoot:.*", "*-PipelineRoot:\".\"*") CurrentDirectory IN ("*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*", "*\\Desktop\\*", "*\\Downloads\\*", "*\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*"))
